data.one_liner: Provides a persistent, app‑scoped device ID for Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: It generates a UUID that is stored in secure platform storage and returned on subsequent calls. The ID persists across app launches but can be reset by clearing data or device changes.
strengths: stable across launches on same installation
weaknesses: ID can change on data clear or device reset
not immutable or guaranteed hardware serial
